card.title: B-25 H
card.text: Deployment: Add a GUNSHIP MISSION to your hand.
card.flavorText: The North American B-25 Mitchell was an American medium bomber that was used by many Allied air forces and in all theaters of WWII. The B-25 Mitchell bombers were frequently used at low altitude and acted as a ground attack aircraft instead of as medium bombers. As a result, modifications were made to the aircraft and B-25G variants and onward, including B-25H, had guns added and unnecessary weight and space was eliminated in order to make it lighter. 1,000  B-25H variants were produced which featured two additional fixed 12.7 mm machine guns in the nose and four in fuselage-mounted pods. Nearly 10,000 aircraft were built in total, including numerous variants.
